title: Count Triplets with Even XOR Set Bits II
description: Given three integer arrays `a`, `b`, and `c`, return the number of triplets `(a[i], b[j], c[k])`, such that the bitwise `XOR` between the elements of each triplet has an **even** number of set bits.

examples.explanation: The only triplet is (a[0], b[0], c[0]) and their XOR is: 1 XOR 2 XOR 3 = 002.

Consider these four triplets:


	(a[0], b[1], c[0]): 1 XOR 3 XOR 1 = 0112
	(a[1], b[1], c[0]): 1 XOR 3 XOR 1 = 0112
	(a[0], b[0], c[1]): 1 XOR 2 XOR 5 = 1102
	(a[1], b[0], c[1]): 1 XOR 2 XOR 5 = 1102

hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Count Triplets with Even XOR Set Bits II.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
